item.title: Meta Ads
item.description:
What Are Meta Ads?

Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram Ads) are one of the most powerful paid advertising platforms available today. With over 3 billion active users across Facebook and Instagram, Meta gives your business direct access to your ideal customers — by age, location, interest, behavior, and more.

At Ad Najah, we don’t just run ads — we build complete Meta ad systems designed to generate consistent leads, drive sales, and grow your brand profitably.

item.title: Google Ads
item.description:
Why Google Ads?

When someone searches on Google, they already have intent. They are actively looking for a solution — which means they are far more likely to buy. Google Ads puts your business at the top of search results exactly when your customers are ready to act.

At Ad Najah, we build conversion-focused Google Ads campaigns that attract high-quality traffic and turn clicks into customers.

What We Do

Keyword Research & Strategy

We identify the exact keywords your customers are searching for. We focus on high-intent, purchase-ready keywords that drive real conversions — not just clicks.

item.title: Social Media Creatives Design
item.description:
The Power of Visual Content

In a world of infinite scroll, you have 1–3 seconds to stop someone from scrolling past your content. That window is everything. At Ad Najah, we design creatives that don’t just look good — they stop the scroll, communicate your message, and drive action.

Our design team blends creative aesthetics with performance marketing principles to produce visuals that work both for organic posts and paid ads.

item.title: Social Media Marketing
item.description:
Build a Brand People Trust

Social media is no longer optional — it is where your customers spend their time, discover new brands, and make buying decisions. A strong, consistent social media presence builds trust, drives engagement, and turns followers into loyal customers.

At Ad Najah, we manage your social media presence end-to-end — from strategy and content creation to community management and performance reporting.

What We Do

Social Media Strategy

We start with a deep dive into your business, audience, and competitors. From there, we build a tailored social media strategy that aligns with your goals — whether that’s brand awareness, lead generation, or customer retention.

item.title: Video Editing
item.description:
Video That Works — For Every Goal, Every Platform

Video is the most powerful content format in digital marketing. It gets more reach, more engagement, more saves, and more conversions than any other format on every major platform. But not all video is the same. The type of video that works depends entirely on your goal, your audience, and where you’re showing it.

At Ad Najah, we edit and produce multiple types of videos — each built for a specific purpose and optimized for the platform it lives on.

item.title: Explainer Video
item.description:
Tell Your Story in 60 Seconds

An explainer video distills your product or service into a clear, engaging story that your audience understands immediately. Studies show that people are 85% more likely to buy a product after watching a video about it — making explainer videos one of the highest-ROI content investments a business can make.

At Ad Najah, we produce professional explainer videos that communicate your value clearly, build trust, and drive viewers to take action.

item.title: Landing Page & Web Design
item.description:
Your Website Is Your First Impression

In 2026, a slow, outdated, or confusing website kills your conversions before they start. Your website is the foundation of all your digital marketing — it’s where ads send traffic, where customers evaluate your brand, and where leads are captured.

At Ad Najah, we design and build high-converting landing pages and websites that look professional, load fast, and turn visitors into customers.

What We Build

High-Converting Landing Pages

Single-page designs built specifically for one goal — a lead, a sale, a sign-up. Every element is designed to guide the visitor toward taking action. Perfect for running paid ad campaigns.

item.title: Content Plan
item.description:
Content Without Strategy Is Just Noise

Posting randomly on social media doesn’t build a brand — it wastes time. A strategic content plan aligns every post, story, and reel with your business goals and audience needs. It ensures consistency, maximizes reach, and builds a community around your brand.

At Ad Najah, we create data-backed content plans that give your marketing a clear direction.

What’s Included in Our Content Plan

Audience & Competitor Analysis

We analyze your target audience and study what your competitors are doing — identifying gaps and opportunities for your brand to stand out.

item.title: Pixel Setup
item.description:
Tracking Is the Foundation of Profitable Ads

Running ads without proper tracking is like driving blindfolded. You spend money but have no idea what’s working. A correctly installed pixel and event tracking setup gives you the data you need to make smart decisions, optimize campaigns, and scale profitably.

At Ad Najah, we set up and verify your tracking infrastructure so every conversion is measured accurately.

What We Set Up

Meta Pixel Installation

Complete installation of the Facebook/Meta Pixel on your website. We configure it to fire on all key pages and actions.

item.title: Server-Side Tracking
item.description:
The Problem with Standard Pixel Tracking

Ad blockers, iOS privacy changes (ATT), and browser restrictions are blocking more and more pixel events. Studies show that standard browser-side pixels can miss 20–40% of conversion events — meaning your ad platform is making optimization decisions based on incomplete data.

Server-Side Tracking solves this problem by sending conversion data directly from your server to ad platforms — bypassing ad blockers and browser restrictions entirely.

item.title: Boosting
item.description:
More Reach. More Visibility. More Results.

Boosting is the fastest way to amplify your best content and reach a wider audience. When done strategically — with the right audience targeting, budget, and creative — boosted posts can deliver impressive reach, engagement, and even conversions at a low cost.

At Ad Najah, we manage your boosting campaigns strategically so every boost reaches the right people and delivers real value.

What We Do

Strategic Post Selection

Not every post should be boosted. We identify your top-performing organic content and select the right posts to boost for maximum return — based on engagement rate, content type, and campaign goal.

item.title: Link Building Optimization
item.description:
আমরা বাস্তব অভিজ্ঞতা, রেপুটেশন ও ক্লায়েন্ট Review বিবেচনা করে বাংলাদেশের সেরা ১০টি ডিজিটাল মার্কেটিং এজেন্সির তালিকা তুলে ধরছি।

বাংলাদেশের সেরা ১০টি ডিজিটাল মার্কেটিং এজেন্সি – ব্যবসার জন্য সঠিক পার্টনার বেছে নেওয়ার পূর্ণ গাইড

বর্তমান সময়ে ডিজিটাল মার্কেটিং ছাড়া বাংলাদেশে কোনো ব্যবসার টেকসই গ্রোথ কল্পনা করা যায় না। ছোট ব্যবসা থেকে শুরু করে বড় কর্পোরেট, ই-কমার্স, শিক্ষা প্রতিষ্ঠান কিংবা সার্ভিস ভিত্তিক কোম্পানি সবাই এখন ডিজিটাল মার্কেটিং এজেন্সির উপর নির্ভরশীল। আপনি কি খুঁজছেন “বাংলাদেশের সেরা ১০টি ডিজিটাল মার্কেটিং এজেন্সি”? তাহলে আপনি সঠিক জায়গায় এসেছেন। আজকের এই আর্টিকেলে আমরা বাংলাদেশের শীর্ষ ১০টি ডিজিটাল মার্কেটিং কোম্পানি নিয়ে বিস্তারিত আলোচনা করব, যাতে আপনি সহজেই সিদ্ধান্ত নিতে পারেন কোনটি আপনার ব্র্যান্ডের জন্য উপযুক্ত। কিন্তু প্রশ্ন হলো, বাংলাদেশের সেরা ১০টি ডিজিটাল মার্কেটিং এজেন্সি কোনগুলো এবং আপনি কোনটি বেছে নেবেন?
